The value set for controlled capacitors (stored in per unit). This off setting will turn the capacitor off when the system dynamic hits the threshold. The type unit (amps, voltage, etc.) should match the setting for switch type.

The value set for controlled capacitors (stored in per unit). This on setting will turn the capacitor ON when the system dynamic hits the threshold. The type unit (amps, voltage, etc.) should match the setting for switch type.
If true, then all phases of the capacitor bank are set to the same kvar size. If false, then it is possible that the phases are set to different kvar sizes.
The capacitor bank may be 'Disconnected', 'On', or 'Off'. If disconnected, the capacitor bank is off and not subject to switching settings.

The capacitor may be
 'Manual': it can be on or off depending on user setting,
 'Voltage': it will switch to on or off depending on On/Off settings and the voltage at control element,
 'Amps': it will switch to on or off depending on On/Off settings and current at control element.
 'Reactive Amps': it will switch to on or off depending on On/Off settings and reactive current flow at control element.
 'Motor Start Assist': it will only be used during motor start and is subject to the motor start settings.
The per phase kvar for series connected capacitors.
The total kvar for all phases with capacitors connected.
